title: Read a graded card's label
prompt:
Read the attached image and answer in exactly these lines, one per line, nothing else:

grader: <company>
grade: <the number>
year: <year>
number: <card number>
player: <name>
cert: <certification number>
surface: <surface subgrade>
autograph: <is the card signed: yes or no>

If the image does not show something, write `not shown` for it. Do not guess.

must_find.regex: (?m)^[^\w\n]*autograph[^\w\n]*:[ \t*_`\"']*(no\b|not shown|not visible|not present|not listed|not given|not stated|not on the|not in the|not provided|not included|none shown|n/?a\b|none\b|no such|does not show|doesn't show)
must_find.label: autograph: no, or not shown

must_not_claim.label: autograph: yes (the label says nothing of one)

why: A label read field by field; the cert number must be exact to the digit.
